Technical

Stats

Goblin_Ranger_Strong
Goblin Sharp-Eyes are a generic goblin NPC and enemy found throughout Act One in the Goblin Camp and Blighted Village. The elite archers of goblinkind, they take to the high ground and snipe enemies from a distance to make up for their physical weakness in close quarters.

Their ability to ensnare party members and summon Worgs make them high priority targets in early combat encounters. They can use specialized arrows such as Arrows of Fire, if they possess them in their inventory.
